company_name.description: The presenting company's name exactly as printed in Arabic, e.g. 'شركة بروة العقارية'

presentation_date.description: Month and year of the presentation as shown on the cover, as YYYY-MM

headquarters.description: Headquarters city and country, as printed in Arabic

reporting_period_end.description: End date of the reporting period the financial highlights cover, as YYYY-MM-DD

currency.description: Reporting currency as an ISO 4217 code, e.g. 'QAR' for Qatari riyal (ريال قطري)

q1_highlights.description: Figures from the key highlights slide for the three months ended on the reporting date (الملامح الرئيسية لفترة الثلاثة أشهر). Arabic-Indic digits (٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩) must be converted to Western digits; the Arabic decimal separator is '.' or '٫' and the thousands separator ',' or '٬'.

operating_revenue_qar_millions.description: Operating revenue (الإيرادات التشغيلية) for the quarter, in millions of QAR

operating_profit_qar_millions.description: Operating profit (الأرباح التشغيلية) for the quarter, in millions of QAR

rental_share_of_operating_revenue_percen.description: Percentage of operating revenue that comes from rental income (من الإيرادات التشغيلية تعود إلى إيرادات الايجارات)

operating_margin_percent.description: Operating profit margin (هامش الربح التشغيلي), as a percentage

net_rental_share_of_operating_profit_per.description: Percentage of operating profit that comes from net rental income

net_debt_qar_billions.description: Net debt (صافي الدين), in billions of QAR

total_assets_qar_billions.description: Total assets (مجموع الأصول), in billions of QAR

cash_dividend_percent.description: Cash dividend distributed for the prior fiscal year, as a percentage (توزيعات نقدية), e.g. 18 for '18%'

dividend_yield_percent.description: Dividend yield on the share price stated alongside the cash dividend, as a percentage

capital_structure.description: Balance sheet and debt figures from the financial liquidity slide (سيولة مالية لضمان توزيع رأس المال بحكمة), in millions of QAR unless stated

bank_balances.description: Bank balances (الأرصدة البنكية), millions of QAR

net_debt.description: Net debt (صافي الدين), millions of QAR

total_equity.description: Total equity (اجمالي حقوق الملكية), millions of QAR

total_assets.description: Total assets (اجمالي الموجودات), millions of QAR

net_debt_to_equity.description: Net debt to equity ratio, as a decimal

net_debt_to_assets.description: Net debt to assets ratio, as a decimal

debt_maturity.description: Debt maturity profile bars (ملف استحقاق الدين), one per year label

year.description: Year label as printed; the last bar is '2030 and after' (2030 وما بعد)

portfolio.description: Operating portfolio scale from the company overview slides

residential_and_worker_units.description: Residential units and labour accommodation rooms in operation

built_up_area_million_sqm.description: Built-up area of operating buildings, millions of square metres
